# The JAX release CI installs, applied as a uv override in ci.yml and pilot.yml (never in
# upstream.yml, whose canary tests newer releases). The golden history pins
# (tests/core/test_golden_histories.py) are bit-exact only under one jaxlib: float64 normal
# draws round differently between jaxlib releases. The goldens read the version from this
# file. Bump it in a commit that changes nothing else; changes/golden-jax-pin.md says
# what to do when the pins move under the new release.
jax==0.12.0.1
jaxlib==0.12.0.1
